title: REMOVE Act
committees: H-Judiciary Committee: Referred To 2025-07-23 -> Markup By 2025-11-18 -> Markup By 2025-11-20
latest_action: Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 14 - 9.
summary: Rapid Expulsion of Migrant Offenders who Violate and Evade Act or the REMOVE Act This bill requires the Department of Justice (DOJ) to complete removal proceedings in immigration court not later than 15 days after commencement. Further, after U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement files with an immigration court a notice to appear that has been served to an individual, DOJ must commence removal proceedings as promptly as possible.

journey.note: Reported by committee; waiting for a floor vote
